import numpy as np

def remove_outliers(xs, k):
    mean = np.mean(xs)
    std_dev = np.std(xs, ddof=0)
    threshold = k * std_dev
    return [x for x in xs if abs(x - mean) <= threshold]
import statistics

def remove_outliers(xs, k):
    mean = statistics.mean(xs)
    stdev = statistics.stdev(xs, ddof=0)
    lower_bound = mean - k * stdev
    upper_bound = mean + k * stdev
    return [x for x in xs if lower_bound <= x <= upper_bound]
